entities.name: Fabián Panisello
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fabián Panisello is an Argentinian-Spanish composer, conductor, and educator. He is the founding director of the Madrid-based PluralEnsemble and Head of Composition at the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid. His works are published by Edition Peters.
